data.name: Atmaan
data.gender_notes: Atmaan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Atmaan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Atman’, which means self or soul. In Hinduism, the self or soul is believed to be a part of the divine Brahman. The name Atmaan signifies the inherent spiritual nature of an individual and encourages the exploration of one’s inner self. The name Atmaan carries the meaning “Self, Soul” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Atmaan usually hope their child will grow to embody self, soul and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner journey towards self-realization and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Atmaan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Self, Soul.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atmaan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
